channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Alcolumbre sinaliza que só votará PEC do fim da 6x1 em agosto
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre signaled that the vote on the PEC ending the 6×1 work schedule will be postponed until after the parliamentary recess on July 18, despite efforts to have it reviewed in the Constitution and Justice Committee this month. He plans to meet with the bill’s authors and government representatives before advancing the text, aiming for plenary approval before the October elections as part of Lula’s re-election campaign strategy.

item.title: Campanha de Marília sobe tom contra PT mineiro: "Desastre político"
item.description: Marília Campos' (PT) campaign criticizes the party's strategy of nominating her as the gubernatorial candidate in Minas Gerais, calling it a 'political disaster' that would unite the right-wing opposition behind a single candidate, such as Governor Mateus Simões (PSD), backed by Romeu Zema (Novo) and Nikolas Ferreira (PL). The pre-campaign advocates for a broad front with a center-party candidate to avoid polarization and strengthen the PT's Senate position, proposing Marília as a Senate candidate instead of a gubernatorial one.

item.title: Moraes arquiva inquéritos contra deputados do PL no 8 de Janeiro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes archived two investigations against federal deputy André Fernandes (PL-CE) and former deputy Sílvia Waiãpi (PL-AP) over alleged incitement related to the January 8 attacks, following the Prosecutor General's Office conclusion of insufficient evidence. The rulings, signed on June 28, 2026, were based on the lack of causal link between the social media posts and the crimes committed that day, the absence of original authorship in Waiãpi's case, and the impossibility of measuring influence in Fernandes' case due to widespread dissemination of the content.

item.title: Crusoé: Pesquisa dispara alerta para Lula no Nordeste
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll, released on June 29, shows a decline in voting intentions for President Lula in the Northeast, dropping from 66% following Senator Jaques Wagner’s (PT-BA) involvement in the Master case. The survey, conducted between June 12 and 14, signals a warning for the PT’s campaign in the region, historically a stronghold. Erosion of government support in the Northeast could affect electoral strategies for 2026.

item.title: Paulo Figueiredo volta a criticar Michelle e diz: “Mulher vota mal”
item.description: Bolsonarist influencer Paulo Figueiredo, ally of Eduardo and Flávio Bolsonaro, criticized Michelle Bolsonaro for claiming she was 'humiliated' by Flávio, saying her video harms his presidential bid among female voters. He asserted that 'women vote poorly', especially single women, and that female inclusion is a 'feminist', 'Marxist' idea incompatible with the right. Figueiredo also clashed with Senator Damares Alves, who defended Michelle and challenged his stance.

item.title: FGTS poderá ser usado como garantia de consignado privado
item.description: The Desenrola Adimplentes program allows formal workers (CLT) to use their FGTS as collateral for private payroll-deductible loans, with a maximum interest rate of 1.99% per month. Coverage reaches up to 100% of the loan value if contracted via CTPS Digital, and up to 50% through other financial institution channels. The initiative expands the Novo Desenrola Brasil, which has already renegotiated R$20 billion in debt and focuses on consumers with good standing.

item.title: Haddad critica 'infraestrutura precária' de Etecs de SP e propõe reforma inspirada em institutos federais
item.description: Fernando Haddad criticized the precarious infrastructure of São Paulo's State Technical Schools (Etecs) and Technology Colleges (Fatecs), proposing a reform inspired by the Federal Institutes model. He highlighted the expansion of these institutes in the São Paulo interior—from 3 to 57 units with over 70,000 students—as a reference to elevate the quality of state technical education. Haddad also criticized Tarcísio de Freitas' administration for the lack of night courses and slow progress in full-time education, noting that many young people must work during the day and lack study opportunities.

item.title: Governo Lula libera R$ 4 bi para Desenrola Adimplentes e Fies
item.description: The Lula government announced the launch of the Desenrola Adimplentes and Fies Empreendedor programs, allocating R$ 4 billion from the National Treasury to expand credit access for informal workers and students current on their student financing. R$ 3 billion will fund Desenrola Adimplentes, offering loans with a maximum interest rate of 1.99% per month and potential additional credit, while R$ 1 billion will support Fies Empreendedor for former students. The funds will be used in reimbursable financial operations with no impact on the primary fiscal balance, and financial institutions will bear the risk.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro se encontra com Javier Milei na Argentina
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), a pre-candidate for the 2026 Brazilian presidency, met with Argentine President Javier Milei at the Quinta de Olivos to strengthen conservative alliances in Latin America. Milei praised the meeting with the phrase 'The blue wave is coming through Flávio Bolsonaro,' referring to a purported right-wing political movement across the continent. During the encounter, Bolsonaro labeled Lula an 'antisemite,' accused the government of severing diplomatic ties with Israel, and pledged to restore Brazil-Israel relations if elected, while claiming Brazil would be 'the missing piece' to consolidate a 'blue wave' in the Americas.

item.title: Jardim diz ter acordo para derrubar veto sobre cortes nas reguladoras
item.description: Federal Deputy Arnaldo Jardim (Cidadania-SP) announced an agreement with government leadership to overturn Presidential Veto 51/2025, which allowed contingency funding for regulatory agencies. The measure, part of a 2025 LDO amendment, aims to ensure financial autonomy for Brazil’s 12 federal regulatory agencies following over R$300 million in budget blocks in May 2026. The vote is scheduled for the rescheduled joint congressional session next week, alongside PLP 73/2025, already approved by the Senate.

item.title: Pesquisa: a queda de Lula no Nordeste após a operação da PF contra Jaques Wagner na Bahia
item.description: President Lula dropped five percentage points in Northeast voting intentions following a Federal Police operation against Senator Jaques Wagner in Bahia, linked to the Banco Master corruption case. His support fell from 66% to 61%, reflecting the negative impact on Wagner’s image, a key PT figure in Bahia — a state critical for Lula’s re-election. The president’s team is adjusting his schedule to avoid joint appearances with Wagner to prevent further political damage to the ally.

item.title: Lula homologa comitiva que o acompanhou em visita oficial a Washington
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ratified, on June 29, 2026, the delegation that accompanied him on an official visit to Washington, D.C., from May 6–7, formalizing the participation of five ministers, the Brazilian ambassador to the U.S., and the Federal Police director-general. The decree, published in the Official Gazette, validates expenses and administrative acts of the mission, concluding its financial accountability and referencing the Constitution and laws governing overseas service.

item.title: Maioria dos brasileiros diz não saber ou não lembrar o nome de nenhum parlamentar, aponta pesquisa
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 75% of Brazilians cannot name a single senator and 68% cannot name a federal deputy, reflecting widespread unfamiliarity with Congress. Among 513 federal deputies, only eight were spontaneously named, with Nikolas Ferreira leading at 6%.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Flávio reforça busca por vice mulher após crise política com Michelle
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reinforced his search for a female running mate following a political crisis involving Michelle Bolsonaro, signaling a strategy of reconciliation and broadening support ahead of the 2026 elections. The move aims to attract female voters and moderate the ticket’s image amid internal tensions within Bolsonarism.

item.title: Milei posta foto com Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Vem aí a maré azul para o Brasil'
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei posted a photo with Brazilian presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro on June 29, 2026, using the phrase 'the blue tide is coming for Brazil' to symbolize the rise of right-wing politics in Latin America. Bolsonaro, attending the Latin America Chairmen's Conference in Buenos Aires, argued that Brazil lags behind neighbors like Peru and Colombia in embracing freedom and order, declaring that this will change in October. He also criticized Lula’s economic policies and stated that Brazil will 'once again be a brother to Argentina'.

item.title: Governo lança Desenrola Adimplentes com juros limitados e mirando dívidas de até R$ 15 mil
item.description: The government launched Desenrola Adimplentes, a new phase of the debt renegotiation program targeting informal workers who are current or up to 90 days late on payments, offering subsidized credit with interest capped at 1.99% per month for debts up to R$15,000. The program allows renegotiation of unsecured personal loans, extension of repayment terms (provided installments do not exceed 90% of the original amount), and access to additional credit of up to 50% of the original debt, backed by the FGO. Additionally, new rules for the Workers’ Credit program were announced, permitting the use of FGTS balances as collateral to cap interest rates at 1.99% per month for formal employees with signed work contracts.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro e Milei se encontram na Argentina, em aceno do presidente a pré-candidato do PL
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of the PL-RJ met with Argentine President Javier Milei at the Quinta de Olivos residence on Monday morning (June 29, 2026), a day after publicly praising the Argentine government at an event in Buenos Aires. The meeting is seen as a gesture of rapprochement between the PL’s pre-candidate and the libertarian Argentine leader.

item.title: Salles sai em defesa de Michelle e diz que candidatura de Flávio é ‘frágil’
item.description: Ricardo Salles defends Michelle Bolsonaro as a stronger presidential candidate to face Lula in 2026, calling Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy fragile. He criticizes Valdemar Costa Neto's influence over Bolsonaro allies in São Paulo, such as André do Prado, and praises Michelle for strengthening the right amid social media attacks. Salles says he would only support Flávio in a runoff, preferring Romeu Zema in the first round.

item.title: Lula lança o Desenrola Adimplentes, para reduzir juros de quem paga contas em dia
item.description: President Lula launched Desenrola Adimplentes, a program aimed at reducing interest rates for consumers who pay their bills on time but face high-cost debts, such as personal loans. The initiative uses the Operations Guarantor Fund to reduce risk for financial institutions and reach approximately 3 million Brazilians, particularly informal workers. Despite government backing, the Brazilian Banking Federation declined to support the program, leaving participation at the discretion of each bank.

item.title: Crusoé: Escândalo Master colou em Flávio e em Lula, indica Nexus
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released on Monday, the 29th, indicates that the Master scandal has tainted both Flávio Bolsonaro, who sought funds from Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film Dark Horse, and President Lula, whose former Senate government leader was targeted by the Federal Police. According to 35% of respondents, political groups linked to Flávio and the Lula administration are involved in the scheme.

item.title: Datafolha: Eleitor que esquece o voto é aliado do parlamentar picareta
item.description: The article criticizes Brazilian voters' distrust in Congress, arguing that many legislators prioritize their personal interests over the public good. This disillusionment leads some voters to abstain or spoil their ballots, which, according to the text, ultimately advantages corrupt or 'crooked' politicians.

item.title: De Silvia Abravanel a Datena: apresentadores precisam deixar TV até esta terça-feira para disputar as eleições
item.description: Television presenters must leave their programs by this Tuesday to run in the October elections, as per TSE ruling. Silvia Abravanel (PSD) has already left 'Sábado Animado' to run for federal deputy in SP, while José Luiz Datena (PSB) was disengaged by EBC and Sikêra Júnior exited his police program in June. Other celebrities like Gracyanne Barbosa (Republicanos) and Val Marchiori (Republicanos) have also announced pre-candidacies, banking on popularity to secure legislative seats in 2026.

item.title: Valdemar se reúne com Michelle para tentar encerrar crise no PL após vídeos de ex-primeira-dama com críticas a Flávio
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto met with Michelle Bolsonaro to address a party crisis triggered by her videos criticizing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The meeting, held at the party’s headquarters in Brasília, aimed to broker a truce before the conflict damages the presidential campaign. Valdemar cut short his U.S. vacation to personally lead mediation efforts, after publicly defending Flávio in Goiás and being barred by Jair Bolsonaro from commenting on the videos.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Flávio é rejeitado por 51% dos eleitores e Lula, por 49%
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has 51% rejection and Lula (PT) 49%, both within the margin of error. In second-round vote intention, Lula leads with 47% and Flávio with 44%, a technical tie. Flávio's rejection increased following Jaques Wagner's removal from Senate government leadership over Operation Compliance Zero.

item.title: Ala do PL defende que Michelle desista de concorrer ao Senado
item.description: A faction within the PL is urging Michelle Bolsonaro to abandon her Senate bid after she released a video attacking her stepson and senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president in 2026. Despite continued respect from party leader Valdemar Costa Neto, she has been increasingly isolated by other party members. The incident highlights growing internal divisions within the PL as candidate selections for 2026 are being finalized.

item.title: Pesquisa testa impacto de barraco entre Michelle e Flávio no sentimento do eleitor
item.description: Atlas Intel will release a survey measuring the impact of the public feud between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro on voter sentiment, following Michelle’s viral video accusing her stepson of mistreatment. The poll examines whether voters believe her claims, which side they support, and how the family conflict affects Flávio’s pre-campaign as the PL’s presidential pre-candidate, even as Michelle is tested as a potential presidential contender.

item.title: Nexus: 22% dos eleitores de Lula e Flávio votariam por rejeição
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll released on Monday, the 29th, shows that 22% of voters supporting Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) would cast their ballots by rejection in a potential presidential runoff. Specifically, 16% of Lula’s supporters would vote for him solely to defeat Flávio Bolsonaro, while 31% of Flávio’s backers would support him to defeat Lula. The findings highlight deep polarization and strategic voting as key drivers among the bases of both candidates.

item.title: BTG/Nexus: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro voltam a empatar, com 47% a 44% no 2º turno
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) are technically tied in voting intention for the 2026 presidential runoff, according to a BTG/Nexus poll released on Monday (June 29, 2026). Lula leads with 47% compared to Flávio Bolsonaro’s 44%, within the survey’s margin of error. Both candidates are identified as the leading contenders for the presidency.

item.title: Zema: '70% dos brasileiros falam Bolsonaro pensando em outro Bolsonaro que não o Flávio'
item.description: Romeu Zema stated that 70% of Brazilians talk about Bolsonaro referring to someone other than Flávio Bolsonaro, the senator. The remark was made at an investor event in Faria Lima, São Paulo, one day after a video in which Michelle Bolsonaro said she had been humiliated by the senator.

item.title: PL teme escalada na troca de farpas entre Michelle Bolsonaro e grupo do Ceará
item.description: The PL leadership attempted to de-escalate tensions between Michelle Bolsonaro and the Ceará-based faction led by Alcides Fernandes after a video in which the former first lady criticized Flávio and other party members. Despite efforts by Valdemar Costa Neto and other leaders to prevent a public response, the initiative failed and the exchange of criticisms continued. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Aprovação de Lula chega a 48%, segundo pesquisa
item.description: The Nexus poll released on June 29, 2026 shows President Lula's approval rating at 48%, tied with disapproval. While 38% rate his government as excellent/good, 42% view it as poor/very poor, with a 2-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. The survey, registered with the TSE as BR-08521/2026, was conducted after recent political events including the Banco Master operation and Michelle Bolsonaro's video criticism.

item.title: DC pretende lançar candidaturas de galã ex-Globo e filha de Roberto Jefferson
item.description: The president of the DC (Christian Democracy), João Caldas, announced plans to launch candidacies for actor Humberto Martins and Cristiane Brasil, daughter of Roberto Jefferson, for federal deputy in Rio de Janeiro in the 2026 elections. The announcement came after the party affiliated with former Supreme Court Minister Joaquim Barbosa, signaling a strategy to recruit well-known public figures to strengthen their ticket.

item.title: Que horas é o jogo do Brasil? Saiba onde assistir à partida contra o Japão na Copa do Mundo 2026
item.description: Brazil faces Japan on Monday (29) at 2:00 p.m. Brasília time at Houston Stadium in the knockout stage of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. The match will be broadcast live on TV Globo, Ge TV, Sportv, Globoplay, CazéTV, SBT and Nsports. The 2026 World Cup will be the first with 48 teams and will be hosted by the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro elogia Milei e diz que, se for eleito, Brasil será 'irmão mais do que nunca' da Argentina
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) praised Argentine President Javier Milei at the Latin America Chairmen’s Conference, promising that if elected in 2026, Brazil would be 'more than ever a brother' to Argentina. He highlighted a purported 'blue wave' of right-wing politics in South America, expressed intent to visit Argentina as president in 2027 to join the Abraham Accords initiative promoted by Milei and Netanyahu, and criticized socialism as an impoverishing model. The trip is part of a campaign strategy to move past the Michelle Bolsonaro controversy and refocus on security, economy, and alignment with right-wing governments.

item.title: Pesquisa BTG/Nexus mostra como fica a rejeição a Lula após caso Jaques Wagner
item.description: The BTG/Nexus poll released on June 29 shows that President Lula's rejection rose from 47% to 49% following a Federal Police operation against former Senate government leader Jaques Wagner, while 38% of voters say they would vote only for him and 12% say they could vote for him but also for another candidate. Approval and disapproval of Lula's government are tied at 48% each, with 4% unsure or not responding.

item.title: Michelle ausente, pedido de trégua e ‘página virada’: o primeiro encontro de Flávio com Bolsonaro após a crise no clã
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro met with his father, Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, following the family crisis sparked by Michelle Bolsonaro’s public criticisms. The former president urged reconciliation and asked his son to halt attacks against Michelle, while Flávio denied intending to hurt her and stressed her importance in uniting the conservative camp. Michelle, absent from the meeting, was recording campaign videos and said the videos were a last resort after failed private attempts to resolve the conflict.

item.title: Disputa ao governo de SP hoje tem menor número de candidatos desde 1986
item.description: The race for governor of São Paulo in 2026 may have the fewest candidates since 1986, with only two declared pre-candidates: Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT). This low turnout reflects a party strategy focused on winning congressional seats, as electoral funding is tied to parliamentary representation. The withdrawals of Paulo Serra (PSDB) and Kim Kataguiri (Missão) raise concerns about a potential first-round victory for Tarcísio.

item.title: Surfista, enxadrista e atacante: como versátil Matheus Cunha superou desconhecimento no Brasil para ser trunfo de Ancelotti na Copa
item.description: Matheus Cunha, Brazil’s forward, uses surfing as a way to disconnect from the pressure of elite football and celebrates his goals with an imaginary surfboard, a tradition rooted in his Northeastern upbringing. Despite never playing professionally in Brazil, he has excelled internationally, playing in four leagues and speaking five languages besides Portuguese, making him a highly adaptable and versatile player. His deep ties to the Northeast — especially João Pessoa and Baía Formosa — remain strong, where he frequently visits to recharge and stay connected to his cultural and emotional roots.

item.title: El Supremo de Estados Unidos se dispone a pronunciarse sobre varios casos que fijarán los límites del poder presidencial
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court, with a conservative majority of six to three, is set to issue pivotal rulings this week that will define the limits of presidential power under Donald Trump, reshaping the separation of powers and the nation’s governance. Decisions issued before the Court’s two-month summer recess will have lasting consequences for American democracy and the balance between the executive and legislative branches.

item.title: Política nacional para superdotados carece de estatísticas fidedignas
item.description: The law establishing the National Policy for Students with High Abilities or Giftedness (AH/SD) was signed by President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, recognizing the need for specialized educational support for these students, similar to that provided for students with disabilities. However, the law leaves gaps, particularly the lack of reliable statistics to inform and monitor the policy. The article emphasizes that without accurate data, it is difficult to ensure these students receive appropriate challenges and are not segregated in the public school system.

item.title: Brasil finge que problemas não existem
item.description: The Vorcaro case, involving suspects across the political spectrum and in the highest echelons of power, is being deliberately ignored in Brasília to avoid triggering an institutional crisis during the 2026 election year. The report highlights a concerted effort to bury the investigation despite the seriousness of the allegations, prioritizing political stability over accountability. This reflects a systemic denial aimed at preserving the electoral landscape.

item.title: Brasil x Japão: onde assistir ao vivo ao jogo da Copa do Mundo de 2026
item.description: Brazil and Japan face off on Monday, June 29, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. Brasília time, at Houston Stadium in the United States, in the Round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup. Brazil arrives with momentum after two 3-0 wins over Haiti and Scotland, following an opening draw with Morocco, and is boosted by Vinicius Júnior's strong performance. Japan also had a solid campaign, drawing with the Netherlands, defeating Tunisia 4-0, and drawing 1-1 with Sweden.

item.title: Moraes deve decidir nesta semana se Bolsonaro continuará a cumprir pena em casa ou voltará para presídio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes is expected to decide this week whether to maintain or revoke the humanitarian house arrest of former President Jair Bolsonaro following the seizure of a pistol registered in his name. Bolsonaro’s defense argues the weapon’s possession does not constitute a 'serious infraction' under prison law, as no judicial order mandated its seizure and the legal provision cited applies to incarceration, not house arrest. The Prosecutor General’s Office also says there is no serious infraction and urges waiting for the conclusion of the weapons investigation before any disciplinary assessment.

item.title: Lula vai a evento na Bahia e deve dividir palanque com Jaques Wagner após crise do Master
item.description: President Lula is set to travel to Bahia this week to attend the groundbreaking ceremony for the Salvador–Ilha de Itaparica Bridge alongside Senator Jaques Wagner, following Wagner’s removal from Senate government leadership after a PF operation linked to the Master case. Lula will skip the traditional July 2 procession in Salvador due to medical advice related to his ongoing radiotherapy treatment. Prior to the Bahia visit, he will make a same-day trip to Paraguay for the 64th Mercosul Summit, where he is expected to announce an increase in Brazil’s contribution to the Focem fund.

item.title: Desenrola dos adimplentes: Lula lança hoje programa para quem paga contas em dia e quer ampliar acesso ao crédito
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva launches today the Desenrola Adimplentes, a credit program targeting consumers who pay their bills on time but face high interest rates. The initiative allows renegotiation of expensive debts into more favorable terms, requiring at least four on-time payments on debts up to R$15,000. The goal is to prevent responsible payers from falling into delinquency due to costly credit, particularly among informal workers.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: um mês após aprovação na Câmara, Senado começa a debater PEC nesta semana
item.description: One month after approval in the Chamber of Deputies, the Senate begins debating the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule. This Wednesday's meeting will bring together government, unions, mayors, and lawmakers to discuss reducing the workweek, aiming to keep the issue prominent as a key electoral platform for Lula. Although the proposal has not yet been referred to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), the debate marks the first official Senate discussion since the PEC arrived.

item.title: Após veto do TSE, AtlasIntel cita Michelle e Wagner em nova pesquisa
item.description: AtlasIntel released a new electoral poll after a TSE veto, including questions about a video of Michelle Bolsonaro criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro and the Operation Compliance Zero targeting Jaques Wagner. The survey also addresses alleged frauds at Banco Master, the proposed U.S. tariff, and U.S.-Brazil relations, though it remains unclear whether the video was shown to respondents.

item.title: Na Argentina, Flávio promete aproximar Brasil de Israel se for eleito
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for presidency, promises to bring Brazil closer to Israel, accusing Lula of antisemitism and stating that, if elected, he will receive the Israeli ambassador on his first day in office and move Brazil’s embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem. He also advocates joining the Abraham Accords and sees Brazil as the missing piece to consolidate a 'blue wave' of conservative governments in Latin America, aligned with leaders like Milei, Trump, and Bukele.

item.title: Brasil x Japão muda horário de INSS, bancos, lojas e supermercados; veja como fica
item.description: The Brazil vs. Japan match in the 2026 World Cup, scheduled for 2:00 p.m. on Monday (29), will alter the operating hours of INSS agencies, banks, government offices, supermarkets, and stores. The adjustment aims to accommodate viewers wishing to watch the game, with early closures or special hours implemented across commercial and service establishments.

item.title: Flávio chama Lula de "antissemita" e diz que mudará embaixada para Jerusalém
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a presidential pre-candidate from the PL party, accused President Lula of being antisemitic during a speech at the Conference of Presidents of Latin America in Buenos Aires. He promised to move Brazil's embassy in Israel from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem if elected and stated that Brazil would once again become 'more brotherly' with Argentina starting in 2027.
